marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology firms report sustained capital expenditure expansion on AI infrastructure during pre-earnings announcements, driving upstream semiconductor suppliers higher.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending validates long-term hardware demand, supporting valuation multiples for chipmakers and server assemblers in both US and related HK supply chain stocks.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of downstream AI software applications and potential revenue margin compression.

marketLayer.title: HK Electric Vehicle Sector
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV manufacturers announced new export milestones alongside aggressive domestic summer promotion campaigns across Hong Kong and mainland equity listings.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas sales expansion offers higher gross margins that offset intense domestic price competition, favoring well-capitalized market leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Escalating international trade tariffs and geopolitical policy shifts targeting Chinese battery and vehicle exports.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong High-Dividend Shares
marketLayer.fact: State-owned energy and banking stocks experienced strong capital inflows as south-bound Connect funds targeted resilient cash flow yields ahead of macro rate decisions.
marketLayer.inference: Defensive positioning remains favored by institutional capital seeking stable income buffers against broader macroeconomic uncertainty.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential shifts in mainland fiscal policies or dividend tax adjustments affecting net investor yields.
